title: Sprint retrospective with many action items
covers: many action items in a short meeting
owners named by themselves, by someone else, or not at all
vague commitments with no owner or date

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: Retro time. What went well, what didn't, and what we change.

segments.speaker: Sam Example
segments.text: Went well: the release went out on time.

segments.speaker: Riley Example
segments.text: Didn't go well: the flaky checkout test failed six times this sprint.

segments.speaker: Sam Example
segments.text: I'll take the flaky checkout test triage.

segments.speaker: Dev Example
segments.text: Someone should clean up the stale feature flags.

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: Riley, could you update the on-call runbook by Thursday?

segments.speaker: Dev Example
segments.text: We should look at the alert noise at some point.

segments.speaker: Alex Example
segments.text: We decided to cap work in progress at three items per person.

segments.speaker: Sam Example
segments.text: Dev, you mentioned the staging database is slow. Can you open a ticket for it today?

decisions.text: Cap work in progress at three items per person.

actionItems.text: Clean up the stale feature flags.
Open a ticket for the slow staging database.

expected.text: ENG-40 Remove stale feature flags already exists and has no owner.
Who owns the alert noise follow-up, and by when?
